scope: App.stop, dispose, finishAndDispose and runShutdownBoundary; excludes App.start implementation, ApplicationShutdown and other app modules from mutation
scorePolicy: Keep all mutants visible and keep raw Stryker score 97.44%; no exclusions or adjusted score. Numeric sample IDs are descriptive, not stable keys.

remaining.proof: finishAndDispose reaches ApplicationShutdown.wait (during startup) or App.stop before any externally supplied cleanup work. Both begin the same idempotent deadline.
